name: Non-planar cladding
summary: A coordinated XYZ surface skin over a known, already-built footprint: single-slope, dome, or saddle heightfields.

evidence.label: EXPERIMENTAL
evidence.scope: Deterministic generator validated by schema, geometry-bounds, and golden-output tests. Not yet evidenced on physical hardware under this exact manifest and generator revision.

rise.description: Peak height above baseZ. Takes priority over `angle` if both are given.

angle.description: Slope angle in degrees, converted to `rise` over `depth` when `rise` is not given directly.

baseZ.description: Z height the supporting footprint already reaches. This operation does not generate that support; see `dependencies`.

dependencyNotes: Not a hard runtime dependency of the generator itself, which only needs `baseZ` and a footprint. Documents the intended composition: a plan typically invokes layer-filling first (wide `settings.spacing`, `wallCount: 1`) to build a sparse support scaffold, then this operation to clad it, with this invocation's process-plan `dependencies` pointing at that scaffold's invocationId.

validation.description: Every emitted point's x/y stays within the declared footprint; z stays within [baseZ, baseZ + rise].
At least one path in the output has more than one distinct z value, confirming genuinely spatial (not per-layer) motion.
Consecutive passes alternate Y direction so the surface is covered by one connected back-and-forth sweep.
